name: Coarse-haired Metallic-Sweat bee
desc: Coarse-haired Metallic-Sweat bee (Lasioglossum imitatum): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 33 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lasioglossum imitatum is a species of sweat bee in the family Halictidae. It is known as the bristle sweat bee.
